column1: The tree is loaded with walnuts.
column2: 這棵樹上結滿了胡桃。

column1: There is a large walnut tree surrounded by several pine trees.
column2: 一棵高大的胡桃樹被幾棵松樹環繞著。

column1: You already have one walnut, let's not be greedy.
column2: 你已經有一顆胡桃了，別太貪心。

column1: These are some of the finest walnuts you have ever seen.
column2: 這些是你見過最上等的胡桃。

column1: You look around and decide these plain walnuts won't do. You want a gold walnut!
column2: 你環顧四周，覺得這些普通的胡桃不合用。你要的是金胡桃！

column1: You pluck a nice walnut from the tree.
column2: 你從樹上摘下一顆漂亮的胡桃。

column1: They are very small and hard to see from here.
column2: 它們很小，從這裡很難看清楚。

column1: The walnuts are over by the walnut tree.
column2: 胡桃就在那棵胡桃樹旁邊。

column1: If you've seen one pine tree, you've seen them all.
column2: 看過一棵松樹，等於全都看過了。

column1: This is a very colorful ceramic bowl.
column2: 這是一個色彩繽紛的陶碗。

column1: You pick up the ceramic bowl.
column2: 你撿起了那個陶碗。

column1: It looks like an interesting, colorful bowl.
column2: 這看起來是個有趣又色彩繽紛的碗。

column1: That is impossible from here.
column2: 在這裡辦不到那件事。

column1: There may have been a bowl here at one time, but it is not here now!
column2: 這裡曾經有過一個碗，但現在已經不在了！

column1: There appears to be some sort of bowl on the ground.
column2: 地上似乎放著某種碗。

column1: Oh No!  That's such a dangerous river... the current is too strong... you won't be able to escape!
column2: 糟了！這是條危險的河流……水流太強……你逃不掉的！

column1: The river flows swiftly between steep banks.
column2: 河水在陡峭的兩岸之間湍急流動。

column1: On the far side of the river is a green meadow.
column2: 河的對岸是一片綠色草原。

column1: The bank is dangerously steep;  there are safer ways to  reach water.
column2: 河岸陡峭危險；還有更安全的方法可以取水。

column1: This is a Raging River filled with boulders and rapids.
column2: 這是怒河，河中滿是巨石與急流。

column1: You see a lovely green meadow on the other side of the river.
column2: 你看見河的另一邊有片美麗的綠色草原。

column1: It is a massive boulder that splits the river.
column2: 這是一塊將河流一分為二的巨石。

column1: You carefully fill the bucket at the river's edge.
column2: 你小心翼翼地在河邊把水桶裝滿。

column1: You drink deeply of the cold river water.
column2: 你大口暢飲冰冷的河水。

column1: You are not close enough to the Raging River.
column2: 你離怒河不夠近。

column1: Your swimming attempt proved fatal!  The raging current drags you under....
column2: 你這次游泳嘗試要了你的命！洶湧的水流把你拖入水底……

column1: You notice an enchanting meadow.
column2: 你注意到一片迷人的草原。

column1: The river is dangerous and powerful.  There is a delta of pebbles on its edge.
column2: 這條河既危險又湍急，岸邊有一片鵝卵石灘。

column1: Your pockets cannot hold any more pebbles.
column2: 你的口袋裝不下更多鵝卵石了。

column1: As you fill the bucket, the river almost rips it from your grasp.
column2: 你裝水時，河水幾乎把水桶從你手中扯走。

column1: The pebbles are round and smooth.
column2: 這些鵝卵石又圓又光滑。

column1: You must venture closer to the river.
column2: 你得再靠近河流一些。

column1: You grab a handful of pebbles.
column2: 你抓了一把鵝卵石。

column1: The only pebbles worth getting are already gone.
column2: 值得撿的鵝卵石都已經被拿走了。

column1: From here it looks like an ordinary delta of pebbles.
column2: 從這裡看，這只是一片普通的鵝卵石灘。

column1: You are not close enough to the pebbles to get them.
column2: 你離鵝卵石不夠近，撿不到。

column1: Your swimming attempt proved fatal!  The raging current drags you under... you are lost....
column2: 你這次游泳嘗試要了你的命！洶湧的水流把你拖入水底……你就此消逝……

column1: There are many smooth pebbles next to the river.
column2: 河邊有許多光滑圓潤的鵝卵石。

column1: There is a small dwarf close by.  It would be a good idea to be careful.
column2: 附近有個小矮人，你最好小心一點。

column1: That little dwarf caught you by surprise.  Is your treasure still OK?
column2: 那個小矮人偷襲了你一下，你的寶物還在嗎？

column1: The quick, little dwarf came by to see what you had -- nothing interested him.
column2: 動作靈巧的小矮人湊過來看看你身上有什麼——結果什麼都沒引起他的興趣。

column1: Dwarfs are quick, little guys who will try to take your treasure.
column2: 矮人們動作靈巧、身形嬌小，總想搶走你的寶物。

column1: There is no dwarf here.
column2: 這裡沒有矮人。

column1: He's too quick for you to catch.
column2: 他的動作太快，你根本抓不到。

column1: No time to talk to him.  He's in too much of a hurry!
column2: 沒時間跟他說話，他趕著要走呢！

column1: It's a good thing you are protected by a spell.  That little dwarf likes to steal treasures.
column2: 幸好你受到魔法保護，那個矮人最愛偷寶物了。

column1: The dwarf sees the goat and decides to leave.
column2: 矮人看見山羊，決定離開。

column1: Being invisible has protected you from the dwarf.
column2: 隱形保護了你和你的寶物，沒讓矮人得逞。

column1: When looking in this small hole, you see a faint green glow.
column2: 你往這個小洞裡望去，看見一絲微弱的綠光。

column1: You would need to be much smaller to fit through that hole.
column2: 你得小上許多，才能穿過那個洞。

column1: This rock is firmly stuck in the ground.
column2: 這塊石頭牢牢卡在地上。

column1: Although you are very strong and healthy, this rock is too much even for you.
column2: 雖然你身強體健，這塊石頭還是太重，連你也搬不動。

column1: Very cautiously, you reach into the hole, and to your dismay, find nothing.
column2: 你小心翼翼地把手伸進洞裡，卻讓你失望的是，裡頭什麼也沒有。

column1: You'll have to move closer.
column2: 你得靠近一點才行。

column1: The ancient, mossy rock has seen many winters.  There is a small hole at its base.
column2: 這塊佈滿青苔的古老岩石，已經歷過許多個寒冬。它的底部有個小洞。

column1: From here it looks like a typical, large rock.
column2: 從這裡看，這只是一塊普通的大石頭。

column1: There are several pretty trees in the area and a few rocks.  One rock has a small hole in its base.
column2: 這一帶有幾棵漂亮的樹木和幾塊岩石，其中一塊岩石的底部有個小洞。

column1: You feel a stretching sensation... Oh, you're back to your original size.  You can't get out of the small  cave!
column2: 你感覺到一陣拉伸感……啊，你恢復原本的大小了。你沒辦法從這個小洞穴裡出去！

column1: One rock has a small hole in its base.
column2: 有塊岩石的底部有個小洞。

column1: Go ahead.  Walk right in.
column2: 儘管走吧，直接走進去就行了。

column1: You notice a hole in the base of a large moss covered rock.
column2: 你注意到一塊布滿青苔的大岩石底部有個洞。

column1: The bucket fills with the somewhat swampy water.
column2: 水桶裝滿了帶點沼澤氣息的水。

column1: In your thirst, even swamp water is satisfying.
column2: 你渴得厲害，就連沼澤水喝起來都很滿足。

column1: This lake looks refreshing, but a little swampy.
column2: 這座湖看起來清涼宜人，但帶點沼澤氣息。

column1: This is a very interesting tree, growing in the middle of the lake.
column2: 這棵樹長在湖中央，十分有意思。

column1: What a pretty bed of wild flowers.
column2: 好一片美麗的野花花圃。

column1: The flowers' fragrance is enticing.
column2: 花朵散發出誘人的香氣。

column1: It would be a shame to pick the lovely wild flowers.
column2: 摘下這些可愛的野花實在太可惜了。

column1: Numerous flowers are growing in the fertile soil.
column2: 肥沃的土壤裡開滿了各式花朵。

column1: As you approach the bridge, a mean, ugly troll appears and refuses to let you cross his bridge.
column2: 你走近橋邊，一隻凶惡醜陋的矮精靈突然出現，不准你踏上他的橋。

column1: Caution and steep banks advise against getting water here.
column2: 河岸陡峭危險，最好別在這裡取水。

column1: You are too far from the river.
column2: 你離河流太遠了。

column1: The wooden bridge is old and weather beaten.
column2: 這座木橋又老又飽經風霜。

column1: The stream may not be safe to cross.
column2: 這條溪流可能不太安全，不宜涉水而過。

column1: Do you really think you can do that?
column2: 你真的以為自己做得到嗎？

column1: Fortunately for you, you have no way to do that.
column2: 算你走運，你根本沒辦法這麼做。

column1: You throw the dagger and the quick old troll catches it.
column2: 你擲出短刀，動作敏捷的老矮精靈一把接住。

column1: You push the troll as hard as you can; he won't budge.
column2: 你使盡全力推那隻矮精靈，他卻紋風不動。

column1: Trools have no sympathy.
column2: 矮精靈可沒有同情心。

column1: There may be something trollish around, but you're not close enough to do anything about it.
column2: 附近或許有什麼與矮精靈有關的東西，但你離得不夠近，做不了什麼。

column1: You throw the dagger and it lands in the stream, lost forever.
column2: 你擲出短刀，短刀落入溪流，永遠消失了。

column1: I don't see a troll.
column2: 你沒看見矮精靈。

column1: Is there a troll?
column2: 這裡有矮精靈嗎？

column1: To what?
column2: 給什麼？

column1: What precious treasure would you like to give to the  old troll?
column2: 你想把哪件珍貴的寶物送給那隻老矮精靈？

column1: If you don't have it, how can you give it to the troll?
column2: 你身上沒有它，要怎麼交給那隻矮精靈？

column1: The troll grabs the treasure and vanishes.
column2: 矮精靈抓起寶物，瞬間消失無蹤。

column1: It seems to me that by now you would have learned to be more careful.  You are stuck in the mud at the bottom of this river and sinking fast.
column2: 看來事到如今，你早該學乖、更加小心才是。你陷進河底的泥沼裡，正迅速下沉。

column1: You see a crotchety old gnome pacing around his lean-to.
column2: 你看見一個脾氣古怪的老侏儒矮人，正在他的窩棚附近踱步。

column1: That is very close but not quite right!
column2: 非常接近了，但還不完全正確！

column1: You have the right idea, but your thinking is just a little bit off.
column2: 你的想法沒錯，只是差了那麼一點點。

column1: That's right!!!  You've guessed it!!  Here are some magic beans for your outstanding accomplishment!
column2: 答對了！！！你猜中了！！這是給你的魔豆，獎勵你這番出色的成就！

column1: The old gnome tells you he has something that may be very useful to you.  Your task is to guess his name in three guesses and his gift will be yours.  Good luck!  What is your first guess?
column2: 老侏儒矮人告訴你，他有樣東西也許對你很有用。你的任務是在三次機會內猜中他的名字，猜中禮物就是你的。祝你好運！你的第一個猜測是什麼？

column1: You still haven't guessed my name!
column2: 你還沒猜中我的名字呢！

column1: The gnome is old and bent under the weight of years, but a playful wisdom still brightens his eyes.
column2: 這個侏儒矮人年事已高、被歲月壓彎了腰，但眼中仍閃著一絲頑皮的智慧光芒。

column1: They look like beans.  Interesting.
column2: 看起來像豆子，真有意思。

column1: It is a heavy, gold, skeleton key.
column2: 這是一把沉甸甸的萬能金鑰匙。

column1: It would be unwise to kill a gnome.
column2: 殺害侏儒矮人可不是明智之舉。

column1: Being careful that you get every one of them, you place the beans in your pocket.
column2: 你小心翼翼地一顆不漏，把豆子全放進口袋裡。

column1: It is heavy and cold.
column2: 它又沉又冰冷。

column1: The gnome can't hear you from there.
column2: 你站在那裡，侏儒矮人聽不見你說話！

column1: You should get a little closer.
column2: 你應該再靠近一點。

column1: There are no beans here.
column2: 這裡沒有豆子。

column1: The key to your problems is elsewhere.
column2: 能解決你問題的鑰匙不在這裡。

column1: There is no gnome here.
column2: 這裡沒有侏儒矮人。

column1: That's too far away.
column2: 那太遠了。

column1: Where did you get that idea?  That's not even close!
column2: 你這想法是打哪來的？差得遠呢！

column1: You know that's not right!
column2: 你自己也知道那不對！

column1: What is your next guess?
column2: 你的下一個猜測是什麼？

column1: You didn't guess the gnome's name, but he left you a gold key anyway.  Better luck next time!
column2: 你沒猜中侏儒矮人的名字，但他還是留了一把金鑰匙給你。祝你下次好運！

column1: There is no place to safely get a drink.
column2: 這裡沒有能安全喝水的地方。

column1: There is no place to safely get water.
column2: 這裡沒有能安全取水的地方。

column1: You slip down the bank into the river far below.  Your cries for help are not heard.
column2: 你從河岸滑落，跌進下方遙遠的河水裡。你的呼救聲沒人聽見。

column1: The gnome's lean-to doesn't look very sturdy.
column2: 侏儒矮人的窩棚看起來不太堅固。

column1: What do you think I am, a car?  This also won't get you a raise.  Nice try.
column2: 你以為我是什麼，一輛車嗎？這樣也加不了薪。想得美。

column1: As you approach the bridge, a mean, ugly troll appears.  He will not let you cross his bridge.
column2: 你走近橋邊，一隻凶惡醜陋的矮精靈出現了。他不准你踏上他的橋。

column1: The old goat seeing the troll, the archenemy of all goats, charges the troll and butts him into oblivion!  The bridge is now yours.
column2: 老山羊一看見矮精靈——山羊們的頭號宿敵——立刻朝他猛衝過去，一頭把他撞得魂飛魄散！這座橋現在是你的了。

column1: This bridge is the only way to cross the river here.
column2: 這座橋是這裡唯一能過河的路。

column1: The river runs swiftly between steep banks.
column2: 河水在陡峭的兩岸之間湍急流動。

column1: Don't do it!  The bank is steep, muddy, and dangerous.
column2: 別這麼做！河岸又陡又泥濘，十分危險。

column1: You can't reach the river from here.
column2: 你在這裡搆不到河流。

column1: This troll is big, strong, and mean-looking.  Don't mess with this troll!
column2: 這隻矮精靈體型高大、力氣過人，看起來凶惡無比。別去招惹他！

column1: It's just about impossible to kill a troll.
column2: 要殺死矮精靈幾乎是不可能的事。

column1: It's lucky you don`t have any way to try that!
column2: 算你走運，你根本沒辦法試試看！

column1: He demands a treasure for passage across his bridge.
column2: 他要求你獻上寶物，才准你過橋。

column1: The dagger sings through the air... to a perfect catch by the troll.  "Nice dagger, but it ain't no treasure!" he growls.
column2: 短刀劃破空氣飛出……穩穩落入矮精靈手中。他咆哮道：「短刀是不錯，可這不算什麼寶物！」

column1: You try very hard to push the ugly troll, but you can't budge him.
column2: 你使盡全力推那隻醜陋的矮精靈，卻絲毫推不動他。

column1: Trolls have no sympathy.
column2: 矮精靈可沒有同情心。

column1: He isn't there!  Try the bridge.
column2: 他不在那裡！去橋上找找看。

column1: You throw the dagger and it falls into the flowing stream.
column2: 你擲出短刀，短刀落入流動的溪水中。

column1: Good news: no troll.
column2: 好消息：沒有矮精靈。

column1: What priceless treasure are you giving the old troll?
column2: 你要把哪件無價的寶物送給那隻老矮精靈？

column1: You don't have any.
column2: 你身上沒有。

column1: You would have to throw it from here!
column2: 你得從這裡把它丟出去！

column1: Grasping the precious treasure in a dirt-covered paw, the troll disappears under the bridge.
column2: 矮精靈用沾滿泥土的爪子抓起珍貴的寶物，消失在橋下。

column1: You have slipped down the muddy bank and lodged in the  river's bed.  Good knight.
column2: 你從泥濘的河岸滑落，卡進了河床裡——晚安了，好騎士。

column1: You have fallen in the raging current and are swept under.  I'm afraid your end has come.
column2: 你跌進洶湧的水流，被捲入水底。恐怕你的大限已至。

column1: It is an old stone bridge dating to ancient times.
column2: 這是一座古老的石橋，年代久遠。

column1: The river gets to be rather rough around these parts.
column2: 河水流到這一帶變得相當湍急。

column1: Very carefully, the bucket fills with water from the  rapid river.
column2: 你小心翼翼地讓水桶裝滿湍急的河水。

column1: Being careful not to slip in, you drink deeply of the cool water.
column2: 你小心不讓自己滑落水中，大口暢飲清涼的河水。

column1: You are too far from the water.
column2: 你離水太遠了。

column1: The clear blue lake is surrounded by a pretty meadow.
column2: 這座清澈的藍色湖泊，四周環繞著美麗的草原。

column1: It tastes very refreshing to a thirsty wanderer.
column2: 對一個口渴的旅人來說，這滋味十分沁涼解渴。

column1: The crystal clear water fills up the bucket.
column2: 清澈見底的水注滿了水桶。

column1: It is an ancient, rusty water pump.  It probably doesn't even work.
column2: 這是一台老舊生鏽的手壓幫浦，恐怕根本不能用了。

column1: The rusty pump doesn't work.
column2: 這台生鏽的幫浦壞了。

column1: The handle has been broken and repaired.  The head shows the signs of many sharpenings.
column2: 斧柄斷過又修補過，斧頭上滿是多次磨利的痕跡。

column1: It was made from rough, hand-hewn logs long ago.  Lately, the upkeep has faltered.  There are even holes in the  roof.
column2: 這是很久以前用粗糙的手削原木蓋成的。近來乏人維護，屋頂上甚至還有破洞。

column1: The old axe is tightly wedged in the tree stump.  You cannot remove it no matter what you do.
column2: 這把老斧頭緊緊卡在樹樁裡，不管你怎麼做都拔不出來。

column1: Upon closer inspection you realize this poor cabin doesn't even have a door.
column2: 你仔細一看才發現，這間破舊的小屋根本連門都沒有。

column1: The trees were cut from these stumps years ago.
column2: 多年前，這些樹木就是從這些樹樁上砍下的。

column1: When you look in the doorway, you see a poor, starving woodcutter and his wife.
column2: 你朝門口望去，看見一位可憐挨餓的樵夫和他的妻子。

column1: How are you going to use the ax when you can't even get it out of this stump?
column2: 你連斧頭都拔不出樹樁，要怎麼用它？

column1: Perhaps you should go inside the house for a better look.
column2: 也許你該進去房子裡看個仔細。

column1: This old cottage is sagging and in great need of repair.
column2: 這間老舊小屋已經傾頹，亟需修繕。

column1: The trees were cut from these stumps long ago.
column2: 很久以前，這些樹木就是從這些樹樁上砍下的。

column1: When you look in the window, you see a poor, starving woodcutter and his wife.
column2: 你從窗戶望進去，看見一個貧窮挨餓的樵夫和他的妻子。

column1: There isn't a glass pane in this window.
column2: 這扇窗上沒有玻璃。

column1: You could get a much better view if you were a little bit closer.
column2: 你要是再靠近一點，視野會清楚許多。

column1: You should really try to find the door.
column2: 你真的該想辦法找到門才對。

column1: You need to go inside to do that.
column2: 你得先進到裡面才能這麼做。

column1: You can't do that now.
column2: 你現在還不能這麼做。

column1: Watch out!!!  There is an ogre nearby!  He will crush you in his strong arms if he catches you.
column2: 小心！！！附近有隻鬼怪！要是被他抓到，他會用強壯的雙臂把你壓碎。

column1: With the magic shield, no harm will come to you.
column2: 有了靈盾護身，你不會受到任何傷害。

column1: Fortunately, you are invisible and the ogre can't see you.
column2: 幸好你是隱形的，鬼怪看不見你。

column1: The ogre's vision is not keen enough to see you.
column2: 鬼怪的視力不夠敏銳，看不見你。

column1: The ogre can see you now!
column2: 鬼怪現在看得見你了！

column1: The dagger is of little use against such a mean creature.  I would save it if I were you.
column2: 短刀對付這種凶惡的生物沒什麼用。換作是我，會把它留著。

column1: OK.  You drop the dagger.
column2: 好，你放下了短刀。

column1: That is a ferocious looking beast.  Please keep your distance!
column2: 那是隻看起來凶猛駭人的野獸，請保持距離！

column1: There is no ogre here.
column2: 這裡沒有鬼怪。

column1: Ogres are practically indestructible.
column2: 鬼怪幾乎是打不死的。

column1: At one time these were very pretty trees.
column2: 這些樹木曾經十分漂亮。

column1: Do you really want to try that?
column2: 你真的想試試看嗎？

column1: The delightful wild flowers brighten up your day.
column2: 這些迷人的野花讓你心情愉快了起來。

column1: Their perfume is joyful, sweet, and light.
column2: 它們的香氣輕盈甜美，教人心曠神怡。

column1: Ogres don't talk, they growl!
column2: 鬼怪不會說話，只會咆哮！

column1: You were warned to be careful around this fierce creature!  Maybe next time you will be able to elude the beast.
column2: 你已經被警告要小心這隻凶猛的生物了！也許下次你就能躲過那頭野獸。

column1: Lucky for you that ogres are afraid of goats. This one decides to leave you alone.
column2: 算你走運，鬼怪害怕山羊。這隻鬼怪決定放你一馬。

column1: You need to be a little closer to smell the flowers.
column2: 你得再靠近一點，才能聞到花香。

column1: This is sad.  You are not the first to fail your quest in the Raging River... I hope you may be the last.
column2: 真令人難過。你不是第一個在洶湧河痛失冒險的人……但願你是最後一個。

column1: This is the wild Raging River filled with boulders and rapids.
column2: 這是狂野的洶湧河，河中滿是巨石與湍流。

column1: It would be dangerous to try and jump across the river on the boulders.
column2: 踩著巨石跳過這條河太危險了。

column1: The land across the river looks enchanting.  You wonder how you can get there.
column2: 河對岸的土地看起來迷人極了，你不禁想著該怎麼過去。

column1: The mushroom is on the far side of the river.
column2: 蘑菇在河的對岸。

column1: This mushroom is large and aromatic.
column2: 這朵蘑菇又大又香。

column1: There is a large mushroom growing in the ground close by.
column2: 附近的地上長著一朵大蘑菇。

column1: You reach down and pick a fat mushroom.
column2: 你彎下腰，摘了一朵肥美的蘑菇。

column1: You see the familiar side of the Raging River.
column2: 你看見洶湧河你熟悉的這一岸。

column1: The colorful mushroom is in the distance.
column2: 遠處有一朵色彩鮮豔的蘑菇。

column1: You need to get closer to do that.
column2: 你得靠近一點才能這麼做。

column1: The river is so swift it is a battle to fill the bucket.
column2: 河水湍急，想裝滿水桶得費一番力氣。

column1: The water from this swift river is cold and sweet.
column2: 這條湍急河流的水，冰涼又甘甜。

column1: You see King Edward's castle on the horizon.
column2: 你看見愛德華國王的城堡矗立在地平線上。

column1: There is a large mushroom in the meadow next to the river.
column2: 河邊的草原上有一朵大蘑菇。

column1: There is nothing of interest around you.
column2: 你四周沒有什麼值得注意的東西。

column1: This lovely meadow is split by the Raging River.
column2: 這片美麗的草原被洶湧河一分為二。

column1: There is no mushroom here.
column2: 這裡沒有蘑菇。

column1: In the depths of the large hole you seem to sense a faint, green glow.
column2: 在這個大洞的深處，你似乎察覺到一絲微弱的綠光。

column1: Don't be afraid... get closer.
column2: 別害怕……靠近一點。

column1: OUCH
column2: 哎呦

column1: I can see you need a little practice climbing rope!
column2: 看來你爬繩索還需要多練習！

column1: You should be more careful before trying that next time!
column2: 下次嘗試之前，你應該要更小心一點！

column1: Your arms are like lead... from swimming.  You find it impossible... to swim any longer.  You sink to the bottom... of the well....
column2: 你的雙臂因游泳而變得沉重如鉛……你發現自己再也……游不動了。你沉入……井底……

column1: The rope is out of reach.
column2: 繩索搆不著。

column1: You cannot climb the sides of the well.  They are too steep and slippery.
column2: 你沒辦法爬上井壁，它們又陡又滑。

column1: When you look upwards, you see the top of the well far, far above.
column2: 你抬頭望去，看見井口遠遠在你頭頂上方。

column1: Although you can only see the bottom of the bucket, it looks like a very nice bucket.
column2: 雖然你只能看見水桶的底部，但看起來是個相當不錯的水桶。

column1: How are you going to get the bucket?
column2: 你打算怎麼拿到那個水桶？

column1: This is murky well water.
column2: 這是井裡的混濁井水。

column1: The water does not taste as good as you expected.
column2: 這水的味道不如你預期的好。

column1: In the midst of your activities, you fill the bucket with well water.
column2: 忙碌之中，你把水桶裝滿了井水。

column1: The knot is tied very tightly.
column2: 這個結打得非常緊。

column1: The rope is secured to the well with a very tight knot.
column2: 繩索用一個很緊的結固定在井邊。

column1: The thick rope resists your efforts.
column2: 這條粗繩不為所動，你使不上力。

column1: You have nothing to cut the rope with.
column2: 你沒有辦法割斷繩索。

column1: Just before slitting the rope, you realize that it is not a very wise move at this time.
column2: 就在你要割斷繩索前，你意識到現在這麼做並不明智。

column1: There is no reason to cut the rope.
column2: 沒有理由割斷這條繩索。

column1: You reach up out of the well water and cut the thick rope that holds the bucket.
column2: 你從井水中伸出手，割斷了固定水桶的粗繩。

column1: You have other things to think about right now.
column2: 你現在該想的是別的事。

column1: A person in your position is in no position to raise or lower anything.
column2: 以你目前的處境，實在沒辦法拉起或放下任何東西。

column1: I don't think that getting in the bucket right now will do you very much good.
column2: 我認為現在爬進水桶裡，對你不會有什麼好處。

column1: You need to be closer to the water to drink.
column2: 你得再靠近水邊一點。

column1: There is no way for you to get water now.
column2: 你現在沒辦法取水。

column1: Now is not the time to try diving.
column2: 現在不是嘗試潛水的時候。

column1: It is a very long, sturdy rope.
column2: 這是一條又長又堅固的繩索。

column1: When the goat saw how dark it was in here, it decided not to stay around.
column2: 山羊一看這裡有多暗，就決定不留在這裡了。

column1: It is empty except for a huge boulder opposite the opening.
column2: 這裡是空的，只有洞口對面一塊巨大的岩石。

column1: It is a rather large, vacant cave.
column2: 這是一個相當寬敞的空洞穴。

column1: It is a huge piece of granite.
column2: 這是一大塊花崗岩。

column1: It is far too heavy to carry around.
column2: 它太重了，帶不走。

column1: It is impossible for you to move a boulder this large.
column2: 你不可能搬得動這麼大的一塊巨石。

column1: It took millenniums for these stalagmites and stalactites to form.
column2: 這些石筍與鐘乳石經過了千萬年才形成。

column1: Looking out the cave opening, you are able to admire the beautiful scenery outside.
column2: 望向洞口，你能欣賞到外頭美麗的景色。

column1: It leads to another portion of the cave.
column2: 它通往洞穴的另一個區域。

column1: It is on the far side of the cave.
column2: 它在洞穴的另一端。

column1: There is nothing of interest on top of the boulder.
column2: 巨石上面沒有什麼值得注意的東西。

column1: The ferocious fire-breathing dragon is protecting the magic mirror.
column2: 這條兇猛的噴火巨龍正守護著魔鏡。

column1: There is a dead dragon, a large boulder, and a seemingly ordinary mirror in the cave.
column2: 洞穴裡有一條死去的巨龍、一塊巨石，還有一面看似平凡無奇的鏡子。

column1: There is a large granite boulder and a magic mirror!! in the cave.
column2: 洞穴裡有一塊巨大的花崗岩，還有一面魔鏡！！

column1: A green, scaly dragon breathing hot fire and smoke is protecting the mirror.
column2: 一條渾身綠鱗、噴著熾熱火焰與濃煙的巨龍，正在守護著這面魔鏡。

column1: In this large cavern, there is a slimy dead dragon, an opening on one side, and a large boulder in the other.
column2: 在這個寬闊的洞穴裡，有一條渾身黏液的巨龍已經死去，一側有個洞口，另一側則有一塊大岩石。

column1: The cavern is empty, save for a couple of openings on either side.
column2: 這個洞穴空無一物，只有兩側各有一個洞口。

column1: There is no dragon here.
column2: 這裡沒有巨龍。

column1: This ferocious, fire-breathing dragon with sharp, green scales and a long tail is protecting the magic mirror. Watch out for the flames!
column2: 這條凶猛的噴火巨龍渾身是鋒利的綠鱗，還有條長尾巴，正守護著魔鏡。小心牠的火焰！

column1: You see the once powerful dragon lying lifeless before you.
column2: 你看見那條曾經威猛的巨龍，如今毫無生氣地倒在你面前。

column1: This boulder is a huge chunk of granite.
column2: 這塊巨石是一大塊花崗岩。

column1: This boulder is far too heavy to move.
column2: 這塊巨石太重了，搬不動。

column1: A strange watery light issues from the hole.
column2: 一道奇異、如水波般的光芒從洞裡透出來。

column1: The mere thought of retrieving the dagger repulses you.
column2: 光是想到要去撿回那把短刀，就讓你感到反胃。

column1: The hole seems to lead further into the cave.
column2: 這個洞似乎通往洞穴更深處。

column1: This dragon had only one life and you have taken it.
column2: 這條巨龍只有一條命，而你已經取走了它。

column1: With that dragon here?  No way!
column2: 那條巨龍還在這裡？想都別想！

column1: This dragon does not respond to reason.
column2: 跟這條巨龍講道理是沒有用的。

column1: You throw your bucket on the cavern floor.
column2: 你把水桶扔在洞穴地面上。

column1: The dragon is protecting the magic mirror.
column2: 這條巨龍正在守護那面魔鏡。

column1: The magic mirror is framed with ornate mahogany wood, polished to a high sheen.
column2: 魔鏡的邊框以華麗的桃花心木打造，拋光得閃閃發亮。

column1: There is no mirror here.
column2: 這裡沒有鏡子。

column1: Carefully, you pick up the magic mirror.
column2: 你小心翼翼地拾起魔鏡。

column1: I do not think that you can get close enough to the magic mirror with the dragon here.
column2: 巨龍還在這裡，我想你沒辦法靠近魔鏡。

column1: You could get a much better view if you were closer.
column2: 你要是再靠近一點，視野會清楚許多。

column1: You are not close enough to reach it.
column2: 你離得不夠近，搆不到它。

column1: You don't have a dagger.
column2: 你身上沒有短刀。

column1: You don't have any water.
column2: 你身上沒有水。

column1: You have nothing with which to douse a dragon.
column2: 你沒有東西可以拿來澆熄巨龍的火焰。

column1: You can't do that from here.!
column2: 你在這裡沒辦法這麼做！

column1: The dagger sings through the air, but falls short of the dragon.  You should have been closer.
column2: 短刀劃破空氣飛出，卻沒能擊中巨龍。你應該再靠近一點才對。

column1: You throw your water, but to no avail.  It lands on the floor and is quickly absorbed.
column2: 你把水潑了出去，卻毫無作用。水落在地上，很快就被吸乾了。

column1: The water hits the dragon squarely in the mouth, extinguishing its roaring flames.  No fire!  How mortified and embarrassed the dragon is!  Moving a huge boulder in leaving, the dragon creeps off to sulk.
column2: 水正中巨龍的嘴巴，澆熄了牠猛烈的火焰。沒了火焰！巨龍又羞又惱！牠搬開一塊巨石，悻悻然地爬走生悶氣去了。

column1: Nervously, you throw the dagger at the dragon and strike it in the heart.  Death for the dragon is instant.
column2: 你緊張地把短刀擲向巨龍，正中牠的心臟。巨龍當場斃命。

column1: How do you wish to accomplish that?
column2: 你打算怎麼做到這件事？

column1: You are too busy looking around to even think about that.
column2: 你正忙著四處張望，根本沒空想那件事。

column1: You should know about these fire-breathing dragons!  Maybe next time you will be a little more careful!
column2: 你早該知道這些噴火巨龍的厲害！也許下次你會小心一點！

column1: Your shield melted from the intensity of the dragon's flames!  You should know about these fire-breathing dragons!  Maybe next time you will be a little more careful!
column2: 你的盾牌被巨龍熾烈的火焰給熔化了！你早該知道這些噴火巨龍的厲害！也許下次你會小心一點！

column1: I think you found the dragon!
column2: 看來你找到那條巨龍了！

column1: Not even you can hold your breath forever.  The well bottom has become your eternal resting place.
column2: 再怎麼厲害的人也沒辦法永遠憋氣。井底如今成了你長眠之地。

column1: This looks like typical well water.
column2: 這看起來就是普通的井水。

column1: It looks like this bottle has been here for a very long time.
column2: 這只瓶子看起來已經放在這裡很長一段時間了。

column1: This is just an old, junky bottle.  You don't want it.
column2: 這只是個又舊又破爛的瓶子，你用不著。

column1: You are at the bottom of the well.  Through the plants you spy what seems to be a hole in the side of the well.
column2: 你正位於井底。透過水草，你瞥見井壁側面似乎有個洞。

column1: It is very difficult to tell where the hole might lead.
column2: 很難看出這個洞通往哪裡。

column1: You are too far away to see clearly.
column2: 你離得太遠，看不清楚。

column1: The rusty old can has been here awhile.
column2: 這個生鏽的舊罐子已經放在這裡好一陣子了。

column1: You have no use for this old can.
column2: 這個舊罐子對你沒什麼用處。

column1: Thrashing around in the water has caused you to lose the magic ring and become visible again.
column2: 你在水中拚命掙扎，害你弄丟了魔戒，也讓你再次現形。

column1: Even as you are reaching for your medevial flamethrower, the King's agents descend upon you.  You are taken away to be torched at dawn.
column2: 就在你伸手去拿中古世紀的噴火器時，國王的侍衛突然撲向你。你被帶走，將於黎明時被處以火刑。

column1: King Edward the Benevolent is a very wise, but elderly monarch.  His frail body is almost lost in the large throne.
column2: 仁慈的愛德華國王睿智卻也年邁。他孱弱的身軀幾乎要淹沒在那張碩大的王座裡。

column1: The King's throne is made of solid gold, accented with rubies.  It will be yours if you complete your quest.
column2: 國王的王座以純金打造，鑲著紅寶石。只要你完成任務，它終將屬於你。

column1: When you bow to King Edward, his pleased smile warms you.
column2: 你向愛德華國王鞠躬，他滿意的笑容讓你心頭一暖。

column1: The King, though very ill, seems happy to see you.
column2: 國王雖然病得很重，看見你似乎仍感到高興。

column1: It is proper to stand directly in front of, and a few paces back from King Edward when addressing His Eminence.
column2: 與愛德華國王陛下說話時，理應站在他正前方，並保持幾步的距離。

column1: You bow, but you are the only one who knows it.
column2: 你鞠了躬，但只有你自己知道這件事。

column1: Go, Sir Graham!  Go and bring me back these treasures!
column2: 去吧，格拉漢爵士！去把這些寶物給我帶回來！

column1: Welcome back from your quest, Sir Graham.
column2: 歡迎歸來，格拉漢爵士。

column1: Why, Sir Graham, have you failed me and returned without accomplishing your task?  Go, and complete your quest!!
column2: 怎麼回事，格拉漢爵士？你辜負了我，任務未成就回來了？去吧，完成你的使命！！

column1: Before exposing your flamethrower, you decide the King is just beyond the range of your obsolete flamethrower.
column2: 在亮出噴火器之前，你判斷國王正好在這具老舊噴火器的射程之外。

column1: You are not close enough to see him clearly.
column2: 你離得不夠近，看不清楚他。

column1: King Edward the Benevolent is sitting on the throne, waiting for you.
column2: 仁慈的愛德華國王坐在王座上，等著你。

column1: It would show more respect if you were closer and in front of King Edward.
column2: 若你能靠近一點、站在愛德華國王面前，會顯得更有禮貌。

column1: He bids you to approach so he can hear you.
column2: 他示意你靠近一點，好讓他聽得見你說話。

column1: The King is walking towards you to commend you.
column2: 國王正朝你走來，準備嘉獎你。

column1: Your heart also aches with pain as you watch the King.
column2: 看著國王的模樣，你的心也跟著揪痛起來。

column1: The King is lying motionless on the ground.
column2: 國王一動也不動地躺在地上。

column1: You are the only King here!
column2: 這裡只有你才是國王！

column1: That's not a bad idea, but the custom in Daventry is to bow.
column2: 這主意倒也不差，不過戴凡確王國的習俗是鞠躬行禮。

column1: To kill King Edward would mean immediate execution!
column2: 殺害愛德華國王等同於立即處決自己！

column1: The throne is already occupied.
column2: 王座上已經有人了。

column1: You will have to do that yourself.
column2: 這件事你得自己來。

column1: This huge, tapestried room echoes every sound.
column2: 這間掛滿織錦的大廳，任何聲響都會迴盪不已。

column1: You move aside as the King steps from his throne.
column2: 國王起身離開王座時，你讓到一旁。

column1: As you approach the throne, the King himself rises to commend  you for a job well done.

column1: The stairs seem to go on forever.
column2: 這些階梯似乎沒有盡頭。

column1: This is a shy little dwarf.  He is too quick to catch.
column2: 這是個害羞的小矮人，他動作太快，抓不到。

column1: Look out!  You are too close to the edge!  Oh, oh, you fell!
column2: 小心！你離邊緣太近了！啊，糟了，你摔下去了！

column1: The quick, little dwarf came by to see what you had-- nothing interested him.
column2: 動作敏捷的小矮人跑來看你有什麼東西——但沒有一樣讓他感興趣。

column1: There is nobody here but you.
column2: 這裡除了你沒有別人。

column1: The dwarf is not here for idle conversion.
column2: 矮人不是來這裡閒聊的。

column1: Being invisible has protected you, and your treasures, from the dwarf.
column2: 隱形保護了你和你的寶物，沒讓矮人得逞。

column1: The stairs descend into the lower reaches of the mountain.
column2: 階梯向下通往山的深處。

column1: You can see sky, light, and smell clouds through the opening.
column2: 你能透過開口看見天空、光線，還能聞到雲的氣味。

column1: Oh dear!  With a slip of the foot, you fall head over heels down the long stairway.
column2: 糟了！你腳下一滑，一路翻滾摔下這條長長的階梯。

column1: If you were to jump or duck here you might fall.
column2: 你要是在這裡跳躍或蹲下，可能會摔下去。

column1: The beanstalk disappears up into the clouds.
column2: 豆莖向上延伸，消失在雲層之中。

column1: With a wrong move, you fall dizzyingly to the ground.
column2: 一個錯誤的動作，你便天旋地轉地摔到地上。

column1: The goat was quite hesitant about climbing that huge beanstalk!  You may have lost the goat.
column2: 山羊對爬上那根巨大的豆莖相當猶豫！你可能已經把山羊弄丟了。

column1: You can no longer see the bottom... it seems to go  on forever!
column2: 你已經看不見底部了……看來這裡深不見底！

column1: You have to be careful when you get so high on the foliage!
column2: 爬到葉叢這麼高的地方，你得小心一點！

column1: Whoops!  You fall toward a distant earth.
column2: 哎呀！你朝著遙遠的地面墜落。

column1: Your heart thuds.  Dare you climb into the clouds?
column2: 你的心怦怦直跳。你敢爬進雲層裡嗎？

column1: It is a long, long way down....
column2: 那可是好長、好長的一段路……

column1: It is amazing that you actually climbed up this high!
column2: 你居然爬到這麼高的地方，真是令人驚訝！

column1: It is hard to believe those seeds you planted grew this high.
column2: 真難以置信，你種下的種子居然長得這麼高。

column1: You are in the Land of the Clouds.  It is rumored a giant lives up here.
column2: 你身處雲之國，傳說有個巨人住在這上面。

column1: While falling through the hole, the magic ring fell off your finger.  Dangerous creatures can see you now!
column2: 你掉落洞穴的途中，魔戒從你的手指上滑落了。危險的生物現在能看見你了！

column1: The warm sunlight falls through the hole in the ceiling.  Unfortunately, you can't reach it.
column2: 溫暖的陽光從天花板的洞口灑落下來，可惜你搆不著。

column1: The dark tunnel leads off to the south.
column2: 這條黑暗的隧道通往南方。

column1: When you fell through the hole, you felt a streching sensation and are back to your normal size.
column2: 你掉落洞穴時感到一陣拉伸的感覺，恢復成原本的大小了。

column1: The further you get from the light, the darker and mustier it becomes.
column2: 你離光源越遠，這裡就變得越昏暗、越潮濕發霉。

column1: Being invisible won't hide you from this rat's keen sense of smell.
column2: 就算隱形，也躲不過這隻大老鼠敏銳的嗅覺。

column1: There is no rat here.
column2: 這裡沒有大老鼠。

column1: It is a big rat with dripping teeth and small, greedy eyes.
column2: 這是一隻大老鼠，牙齒滴著口水，眼睛小而貪婪。

column1: It is very dark and dreary.  The rat seems to like it here.
column2: 這裡又暗又陰森，那隻大老鼠似乎很喜歡待在這裡。

column1: It is very dark and dreary in here.
column2: 這裡又暗又陰森。

column1: This is no mouse, this is a big, ugly rat!
column2: 這可不是老鼠，這是一隻又大又醜的大老鼠！

column1: The door slowly opens.
column2: 門緩緩打開了。

column1: The door is closed.
column2: 門已經關上了。

column1: Be careful around this rat next time!  He's dangerous!!
column2: 下次小心那隻大老鼠！牠很危險！！

column1: The door appears to be stuck and won't close.
column2: 這扇門似乎卡住了，關不上。

column1: Get closer if you want to try.
column2: 想試試看的話，先靠近一點。

column1: You can't.  He moves too quickly.
column2: 你辦不到，牠的動作太快了。

column1: The rat rasps, "Treasure!  Treasure!  Give treasure, or no go door!  Give treasure NOW!"
column2: 大老鼠沙啞地說：「寶物！寶物！交出寶物，不然別想過門！現在就交出寶物！」

column1: You have no treasure to give the rat.
column2: 你身上沒有寶物可以給那隻大老鼠。

column1: The rat doesn't want an ordinary walnut.
column2: 大老鼠不想要一顆普通的胡桃。

column1: The rat doesn't want a tattered pouch.
column2: 大老鼠不想要一個破爛的皮袋。

column1: What kind of treasure would you like to give the  greedy rat?
column2: 你想給這隻貪心的大老鼠什麼樣的寶物？

column1: The huge rat takes the treasure you have offered and scuttles away.
column2: 那隻巨大的老鼠接過你獻上的寶物，飛快地跑走了。

column1: It appears you are afraid of the rat!  You must get closer to give anything to this rat!
column2: 看來你很怕那隻大老鼠！你得靠近一點，才能把東西交給牠！

column1: You do not have any.
column2: 你身上沒有這東西。

column1: The rat drools at the sight of the cheese... and snatches it from your hand.  You might want to count your fingers.
column2: 大老鼠一看到乳酪就流口水……一把從你手中搶走。你也許該數數自己的手指還在不在。

column1: The rat scrambles to the wall and seems to magically merge with it.
column2: 大老鼠竄向牆壁，彷彿被魔法融進牆裡消失了。

column1: That is a good idea, but you do not have any cheese.
column2: 這主意不錯，可惜你身上沒有乳酪。

column1: You count your fingers and are relieved to see you still have all of them.
column2: 你數了數自己的手指，鬆了口氣，發現十根都還在。

column1: The leprechauns' magic powers detect your unseen presence.
column2: 地穴人的魔法察覺到你隱形的存在。

column1: The leprechauns do not like your invasion of their territory.  They may not let you get any further.
column2: 地穴人不喜歡你入侵他們的地盤，他們可能不會讓你再往前一步。

column1: The leprechauns revere the power of the fourleaf clover. With it in your possession they will leave you absolutely alone.
column2: 地穴人敬畏幸運草的力量，只要你身上帶著它，他們就絕對不會來打擾你。

column1: Leprechauns love fiddle music!  Have you ever seen such frenzied dancing?
column2: 地穴人最愛小提琴的音樂！你看過這麼瘋狂的舞蹈嗎？

column1: Totally involved in the music, they dance right out of the room.
column2: 他們完全沉浸在音樂裡，一路跳著舞離開了房間。

column1: The leprechaun catches you and holds you with his small,  but strong arms.  I don't think the leprechaun will ever let go.
column2: 地穴人抓住了你，用他矮小卻強壯的雙臂緊緊抱住你。我想他大概永遠不會放手了。

column1: You are in the antechamber of the Hall of the Leprechaun King.  There are leprechauns in the room with you.
column2: 你身處地穴人國王大廳的前廳，房間裡還有其他地穴人。

column1: You are in the antechamber of the Hall of the Leprechaun King.
column2: 你站在地穴人國王大殿的前廳。

column1: I can think of no good reason to close the door.
column2: 我實在想不出關門的理由。

column1: They are tiny people dressed all in green.
column2: 他們是一群身形嬌小、渾身穿著綠衣的人。

column1: I would not try talking to the leprechauns.  You might say the wrong thing.
column2: 我勸你別跟地穴人搭話，你可能會說錯話。

column1: You would not get all of them before they got you.
column2: 你還沒抓到他們全部，他們就先抓住你了。

column1: There are not any leprechauns here.
column2: 這裡沒有地穴人。

column1: You are already playing the fiddle.
column2: 你已經在拉小提琴了。

column1: You find playing the fiddle here very fun, but the dance floor is in the other room.
column2: 在這裡拉小提琴挺有趣的，不過舞池在隔壁房間。

column1: You play a little tune on the fiddle to amuse yourself.
column2: 你拉了一小段曲子自娛自樂。

column1: It is very difficult to play a fiddle if you do not have one.
column2: 沒有小提琴，很難拉得出曲子。

column1: This is a rather simple stone throne, compared to King Edward's.
column2: 比起愛德華國王的王座，這座石座顯得相當樸素。

column1: The little green men do not seem to be noticing you; perhaps because of the fourleaf clover.
column2: 這些綠色小人似乎沒注意到你，也許是幸運草的緣故。

column1: There aren't any leprechauns here.
column2: 這裡沒有地穴人。

column1: The King of the leprechauns is sitting on the stone throne. The magic shield is next to the throne.
column2: 地穴人國王坐在石造王座上，靈盾就放在王座旁邊。

column1: The King of the leprechauns is sitting on the stone throne.
column2: 地穴人國王坐在石造王座上。

column1: The King is leaving.
column2: 國王正要離開。

column1: The King of the leprechauns is no longer here.
column2: 地穴人國王已經不在這裡了。

column1: The stairs go up a narrow tunnel.
column2: 階梯通往一條狹窄的隧道。

column1: To see the stairs, you have to get closer.
column2: 你得靠近一點，才能看清楚那道階梯。

column1: The leprechaun King ignores your words.
column2: 地穴人國王對你的話置之不理。

column1: I hope you can escape from the leprechauns, but it doesn't look good for you.
column2: 希望你能逃過地穴人的手掌心，不過看來情況對你不太妙。

column1: The leprechaun, with much support from his peers, catches you and refuses to let go.  I think you will be here for a long, long time.
column2: 那個地穴人在同伴的協助下抓住了你，說什麼也不肯放手。我看你要在這裡待上好長一段時間了。

column1: The King's magic prevents you from getting close enough to harm him.
column2: 國王的魔法讓你無法靠近到能傷害他的距離。

column1: After his followers have danced away, the King of the leprechauns realizes he can lead best by following, and leaves, forgetting his beautiful sceptre.
column2: 隨著臣民跳舞遠去，地穴人國王領悟到，跟隨才是最好的領導方式，於是也跟著離去，忘了帶走他美麗的王杖。

column1: The shield is already in your pocket.
column2: 靈盾已經在你的口袋裡了。

column1: I think there might have been a shield here once, but someone has since taken it.
column2: 我想這裡原本可能有面盾牌，但已經被人拿走了。

column1: The shield is no longer here.
column2: 這裡已經沒有盾牌了。

column1: It is made of titanium and is rimmed with jewels.
column2: 靈盾以鈦金屬打造，邊緣鑲著珠寶。

column1: As inconspicuously as possible, you add the shield to what you are carrying.
column2: 你不動聲色地把靈盾收進了行囊。

column1: You take the magic shield and carefully put it in your pocket.
column2: 你拿起靈盾，小心翼翼地放進口袋。

column1: You need to get closer to see it clearly.
column2: 你得靠近一點才能看清楚。

column1: You must be closer to do that.
column2: 你得靠近一點才能這麼做。

column1: The sceptre is fashioned from gold and silver, and accented with emeralds.
column2: 這根王杖以金銀打造，並鑲嵌著翡翠點綴。

column1: I see no sceptre right here.
column2: 這裡沒看到什麼王杖。

column1: I see no sceptre to get around here.
column2: 這附近沒看到可以拿的王杖。

column1: Eagerly, you pick up the sceptre.
column2: 你迫不及待地拾起了王杖。

column1: I see no sceptre in the vicinity.
column2: 這附近沒看到王杖。

column1: There is no sceptre in sight to get.
column2: 視線範圍內沒有可拿的王杖。

column1: The leprechauns seem irritated by your invasion of their territory.  I would be real careful about what I say and do right now!
column2: 地穴人似乎對你入侵他們的地盤感到惱怒。我勸你現在言行都得格外小心！

column1: This is the throne room of the leprechaun King.
column2: 這裡是地穴人國王的王座廳。

column1: This is the throne room of the leprechaun King.  There is a shield and a sceptre near the throne.
column2: 這裡是地穴人國王的王座廳，王座附近有一面盾牌和一根王杖。

column1: This is the throne room of the leprechaun King.  There is a shield next to the throne.
column2: 這裡是地穴人國王的王座廳，王座旁邊有一面盾牌。

column1: This is the throne room of the leprechaun King.  There is a sceptre next to the throne.
column2: 這裡是地穴人國王的王座廳，王座旁邊有一根王杖。

column1: The stairs are very steep and narrow.
column2: 這道階梯又陡又窄。

column1: The small hole leads to the outside world.
column2: 這個小洞通往外面的世界。

column1: You are much too big to fit through that small hole.
column2: 你的身形太大了，鑽不過那個小洞。

column1: This is a small cave with stairs on one side and a very small hole on the other side.
column2: 這是一個小洞穴，一側有階梯，另一側有個非常小的洞。

column1: You seem to be stuck in these underground caverns.  As you have no way of leaving, it looks like you'll spend the rest of your life here.
column2: 你似乎被困在這片地底洞穴裡。既然沒有辦法離開，看來你得在這裡度過餘生了。

column1: You dare not jump here or you would go through the floor!
column2: 你可不敢在這裡跳，不然會直接摔穿地板！

column1: The cottage is run-down and sparsely furnished.  The only nice possession seems to be a fiddle in the corner.
column2: 這間小屋破舊不堪，家具寥寥無幾，唯一像樣的東西似乎是角落那把小提琴。

column1: The cottage is run-down and sparsely furnished.
column2: 這間小屋破舊不堪，家具寥寥無幾。

column1: This family is so poor, they can't even repair the floor.
column2: 這戶人家窮到連地板都修不起。

column1: This is the woodcutter's fiddle.
column2: 這是樵夫的小提琴。

column1: The woodcutter is thin and dressed in rags.
column2: 樵夫瘦骨嶙峋，衣衫襤褸。

column1: The woodcutter's wife is skinny and poorly dressed.
column2: 樵夫的妻子骨瘦如柴，衣著寒酸。

column1: The woodcutter and his wife are sitting at the old oak table.
column2: 樵夫和他的妻子坐在那張老橡木桌旁。

column1: Welcome to my humble abode.
column2: 「歡迎來到寒舍。」

column1: She replies, "I'd like to offer you something, but we do not even have food for ourselves."
column2: 她回答道：「我很想招待你，可是我們連自己的食物都不夠了。」

column1: Make yourself at home in our humble home.
column2: 「請把這寒舍當自己家吧。」

column1: That would be very nice.  How do you want to help them?
column2: 這真是個好主意，你想怎麼幫助他們呢？

column1: What an abominable idea!  You should be ashamed of yourself for even suggesting such a thing!
column2: 這主意真是可惡！你居然想得出這種點子，該感到羞愧！

column1: It is closed, but in this house, all the cabinets are bare.
column2: 櫃子關著，不過在這戶人家裡，所有的櫥櫃都是空的。

column1: The cabinet is all but bare.
column2: 這個櫥櫃幾乎是空的。

column1: The beautiful scenery outside is in contrast to the dreariness inside.
column2: 屋外的美麗景色，和屋內的淒涼景象形成強烈對比。

column1: You should have more sympathy for these poor folks!
column2: 你應該多同情一下這些可憐人！

column1: You have given the bowl to these poor people and it is now theirs.  You have no right to take it back.
column2: 你已經把碗送給這對可憐的夫妻了，它現在是他們的東西，你沒有權利拿回來。

column1: The woodcutters admire the bowl as it sits on their table.
column2: 樵夫夫妻欣賞著放在桌上的那只碗。

column1: What treasure do you wish to donate to them?
column2: 你想捐贈什麼寶物給他們？

column1: The woodcutter and his wife very gratefully accept the treasure.  "This will help us for awhile," says the woodcutter.
column2: 樵夫和他的妻子滿懷感激地收下了寶物。樵夫說：「這能幫我們撐一陣子了。」

column1: This is a nice thought, but unfortunately you have nothing to give these poor people.
column2: 這番心意很好，可惜你身上沒有東西能給這對可憐的夫妻。

column1: The woodcutter and his wife kindly accept your gift of food.  They offer a heartfelt "Thank you."
column2: 樵夫和他的妻子親切地收下了你贈送的食物，由衷地向你道謝。

column1: Puzzled, the couple wonders why you have given them a bowl.
column2: 這對夫妻一頭霧水，不明白你為什麼給他們一只碗。

column1: The woodcutter family is very grateful that you have given them a bowl of stew.  Now they will have at least one last meal.  As a token of their gratitude, they offer their last earthly possession, the woodcutter's fiddle.
column2: 樵夫一家對你送上的這碗燉肉萬分感激，這下他們至少能吃上最後一餐了。為了表達謝意，他們獻上了僅剩的財產——樵夫的那把小提琴。

column1: Eat stew from an empty bowl?  The woodcutters are beginning to question your authenticity.
column2: 從空碗裡吃燉肉？樵夫夫妻開始懷疑你是不是有問題。

column1: The stew looks delicious, but it is no longer yours.  Now you will have to do without.
column2: 這碗燉肉看起來很美味，可惜已經不是你的了，你現在只能餓著了。

column1: The couple is amazed and delighted as the bowl miraculously fills with a bubbling stew.  As a token of their gratitude, they offer their last earthly possession, the woodcutter's fiddle.
column2: 這對夫妻又驚又喜，眼看著碗裡奇蹟般地冒出滾燙的燉肉。為了表達謝意，他們獻上了僅剩的財產——樵夫的那把小提琴。

column1: The couple does not understand.
column2: 這對夫妻聽不懂。

column1: The fiddle is a beautiful instrument made of polished wood.
column2: 這把小提琴是用打磨光亮的木材製成的精美樂器。

column1: You cannot take their last precious possession!
column2: 你不能拿走他們僅剩的珍貴財產！

column1: The polished wood feels like satin -- it seems to still vibrate from the last song it played.
column2: 打磨過的木頭摸起來像緞子一樣光滑——彷彿還殘留著上一首曲子的餘韻在震動。

column1: What a terrible suggestion!  These people are poor and starving and you want to steal one of their last earthly possessions.
column2: 這主意真是糟透了！這些人又窮又餓，你居然想偷走他們僅剩的財產之一。

column1: You cannot see it very well from here.
column2: 從這裡看不太清楚。

column1: I doubt that you will get away with it, but you will have to get closer to try.
column2: 我不認為你能得逞，不過你得先靠近一點才能試試看。

column1: These poor people can't even afford to repair the floor!  Sorry about that.
column2: 這對可憐的夫妻連地板都修不起！抱歉了。

column1: As soon as you entered the house the old goat ran away.
column2: 你一走進屋子，那隻老山羊就跑掉了。

column1: Hello
column2: 「哈囉」

column1: There is an empty bowl sitting on the old oak table.

column1: We, at Sierra, wish to thank you for playing King's Quest. We are delighted by your score and hope you are enjoying the game.
column2: 我們 Sierra 全體同仁感謝你遊玩《國王密令》。你的分數令人欣喜，希望你樂在其中。

column1: As you will never get out of this cage alive, I can only permit you to: Restore Game, Restart Game or Take Inventory. Sorry.
column2: 由於你不可能活著離開這座牢籠，目前只能執行：讀取進度、重新開始或查看物品欄。抱歉。

column1: Unfortunately, with the moat population swimming is not possible.
column2: 很遺憾，護城河裡棲息著大量生物，沒辦法在此游泳。

column1: You need to be in the water in order to swim.
column2: 你得先進到水裡才能游泳。

column1: You are already swimming!
column2: 你已經在游泳了！

column1: The swift current does not allow for swimming.
column2: 湍急的水流讓你沒辦法游泳。

column1: It appears you have become normal size again.
column2: 看來你已經恢復成正常大小了。

column1: You see nothing special.
column2: 你沒看見什麼特別的東西。

column1: You cannot get the "%w2". At least not now!
column2: 你現在還拿不到「%w2」，至少現在不行！

column1: There is no reason to do that.
column2: 沒有理由這麼做。

column1: The "%w2" doesn't appeal just now.
column2: 「%w2」現在引不起你的興趣。

column1: No. That would just waste time.
column2: 不行，那只會浪費時間。

column1: You can try to go there.
column2: 你可以試著往那裡走。

column1: That would be inappropriate at this time.
column2: 現在這麼做並不恰當。

column1: Hello."
column2: 你好。」

column1: You will have to find him yourself.
column2: 你得自己去找到他。

column1: You will have to find her yourself.
column2: 你得自己去找到她。

column1: You will have to find it yourself.
column2: 你得自己去找到它。

column1: There is no "%w2" here.
column2: 這裡沒有「%w2」。

column1: What do you wish to do with it???
column2: 你想拿它做什麼？？？

column1: You can't eat the mushroom if you don't have it!
column2: 你身上沒有蘑菇，怎麼吃得到！

column1: You can't do that--at least not now!
column2: 你沒辦法這麼做──至少現在不行！

column1: Not right now!
column2: 現在不行！

column1: There is nobody here but you!
column2: 這裡除了你沒有別人！

column1: You can't do that.
column2: 你沒辦法這麼做。

column1: Just say what you wish to get.
column2: 直接說出你想拿的東西。

column1: You get no response from the "%w2".
column2: 「%w2」沒有任何回應。

column1: I don't understand "%w1".
column2: 我聽不懂「%w1」。

column1: I don't understand "%w2".
column2: 我聽不懂「%w2」。

column1: I don't understand "%w3".
column2: 我聽不懂「%w3」。

column1: Fill what?
column2: 要裝滿什麼？

column1: You have better things to do than to play all day.
column2: 你該做點正事，別成天只顧著玩。

column1: What would you like to climb?
column2: 你想爬什麼？

column1: Well.  Go look for it.
column2: 好吧，去找找看吧。

column1: This is a very beautiful tree.
column2: 這是一棵非常美麗的樹。

column1: This is just a normal tree, but very pretty.
column2: 這只是一棵普通的樹，但很漂亮。

column1: You admire the beauty of the tree.
column2: 你欣賞著這棵樹的美。

column1: This is a very nice looking rock.
column2: 這是一顆看起來很不錯的石頭。

column1: There is nothing extraordinary about this rock.
column2: 這顆石頭沒什麼特別之處。

column1: This is your ordinary rock.
column2: 這只是顆普通的石頭。

column1: There is no "%w2" here to look at.
column2: 這裡沒有「%w2」可以看。

column1: You do not have any water.
column2: 你身上沒有水。

column1: There is no door here.
column2: 這裡沒有門。

column1: The goat does not mind getting its feet wet,but will not swim in the water.  You should go back and lead the goat around the water.
column2: 山羊不介意弄濕腳，但牠不會游泳。你該回頭，帶著山羊繞過那片水域。

column1: The goat, not being able to see you, wanders off.
column2: 山羊看不見你，於是四處遊蕩離去。

column1: You are already climbing the beanstalk.
column2: 你已經在爬豆莖了。

column1: It is a mighty beanstalk that stretches to the sky.
column2: 這是一株雄偉的豆莖，直聳雲霄。

column1: Since you are invisible, everything you own is invisible.  The goat cannot see the carrot.
column2: 你現在是隱形的，身上的東西也跟著隱形。山羊看不見那根胡蘿蔔。

column1: It is a well known fact that goats hate trolls intensely.   You should move aside and let the goat take care of this nasty troll.
column2: 眾所皆知，山羊對矮精靈恨之入骨。你該讓到一旁，讓山羊去對付這個討厭的傢伙。

column1: You feel a stretching sensation... Oh, you're back to your original size.  You can't get out of the small cave!
column2: 你感覺身體正在伸展……啊，你恢復成原本的大小了。這下你出不了這個小洞穴！

column1: Its handle is beautifully carved; the blade is bronze and very sharp!
column2: 刀柄雕工精美，青銅打造的刀刃鋒利無比！

column1: You admire the workmanship of the beautiful chest.
column2: 你欣賞著這只華美金盒子的做工。

column1: This is one of the tastiest looking carrots you have ever seen.
column2: 這是你見過最秀色可餐的胡蘿蔔之一。

column1: You proudly admire your gold walnut.
column2: 你得意地端詳著你的金胡桃。

column1: You take the key from your pocket and take a long look at it.
column2: 你從口袋裡拿出鑰匙，端詳了好一會兒。

column1: There is a message written on the note.
column2: 紙條上寫著一段訊息。

column1: The ring is gold with a breathtaking tiger's eye stone perched on top.
column2: 這只金戒指上鑲著一顆令人屏息的虎眼石。

column1: You have a perfectly shaped four-leaf clover.
column2: 你有一株形狀完美的幸運草。

column1: You notice a word on the bottom of the bowl.
column2: 你注意到碗底寫著一個字。

column1: The bowl is full of a delicious looking stew.
column2: 碗裡盛滿了看起來很美味的燉肉。

column1: The bucket is old and weathered.
column2: 這只水桶又舊又飽經風霜。

column1: The old bucket is full of water.
column2: 舊水桶裡裝滿了水。

column1: The pebbles are worn smooth by the Raging River.
column2: 這些鵝卵石被怒河磨得光滑圓潤。

column1: The sling was made by a fine craftsman.
column2: 這只投石器出自巧匠之手。

column1: The diamonds, in the pouch, glisten beautifully in the light.
column2: 皮袋裡的鑽石在光線下閃爍生輝。

column1: The tattered pouch is made of a coarse canvas.
column2: 這只破舊的皮袋是粗帆布做的。

column1: The elegance of the sceptre is incomprehensible.
column2: 這根王杖華美得難以言喻。

column1: The Swiss cheese looks fresh and moist.
column2: 這塊瑞士乳酪看起來新鮮又濕潤。

column1: As you are holding the magic mirror, you look into it and see a vision of yourself with a crown on your head.
column2: 你握著魔鏡往裡看，鏡中浮現戴著王冠的自己。

column1: The smooth golden egg shines brightly in the sunlight.
column2: 光滑的金蛋在陽光下閃閃發亮。

column1: It is made from titanium and edged with emeralds.
column2: 它以鈦金屬打造，邊緣鑲著綠寶石。

column1: The fiddle is fashioned from polished cherry wood.
column2: 這把小提琴以打磨過的櫻桃木製成。

column1: It seems to be a good, solid walnut.
column2: 看起來是顆結實飽滿的胡桃。

column1: This is a large, grey mushroom.
column2: 這是一朵灰色的大蘑菇。

column1: They look like plain, ordinary beans.
column2: 看起來就是再普通不過的豆子。
